data.name: Spandan
data.gender_notes: Spandan is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Spandan means explosion or expansion in Sanskrit and Hindi. It signifies the feeling of pure joy and delight, as if an inner explosion of happiness has taken place. This name is often given to a baby girl as a symbol of the joy and excitement that her arrival brings. The name Spandan carries the meaning “Explosion, Joy, Delight” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Spandan usually hope their child will grow to embody explosion, joy, delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Spandan is a Sanskrit and Hindi name that represents the spiritual concept of expansion and joy. It is derived from the word 'spandana,' which means 'explosion' or 'expansion.' In Hinduism, this name is associated with the idea of the universe expanding and contracting, and the joy and excitement that comes with this cycle of life.
data.etymology: Spandan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Explosion, Joy, Delight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Spandan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
